description: Gamut mapping into sRGB by OKLCh chroma reduction (F-009). Every entry is `definitional`: the expected value is the largest chroma at the input lightness and hue whose sRGB rendering fits in [0,1], which any correct chroma-reduction mapper must reproduce. The test asserts that boundary property directly — the result is in gamut AND one step more chroma is not — so an entry cannot pass by the implementation merely agreeing with itself. Independently cross-checked against culori clampChroma, an implementation of the same algorithm. NOT the same as CSS Color 4 toGamut({method:"css"}), which adds a MINDE early stop and drifts hue up to 11.97 degrees; that deviation is deliberate and measured in ADR-0045.

entries.source: CSS Color 4 §13.2 (gamut mapping by OKLCh chroma reduction); the gamut boundary itself is defined by the sRGB primaries of IEC 61966-2-1. See ADR-0045 for the deliberate omission of the MINDE step.
entries.derivationNote: display-p3 red: the largest OKLCh chroma at L=0.648574075144298 H=28.9581327308039 whose sRGB rendering fits [0,1]. Chroma 0.299485286338369 -> 0.237532228251319. On the gamut boundary: one bisection step more chroma does not fit. Independently reproduced by culori clampChroma as [0.999979746063161, 0.203529144040024, 0.158811868634639].
